$comment: Email domains that can never be a Union Ground account address (REQ-UG-BLOCK-GOVERNMENT-AND-EMPLOYER-EMAIL-DOMAINS-20261102, owner todo of Nov 1, 2026): no account is created with one and no account email is changed to one. A domain matches a rule when it is the rule's domain or a subdomain of it. topLevel: the last label (gov, mil). countrySecondLevel: the label before a two-letter country code (gov.uk, gob.mx, go.jp). suffixes: other government domains. usStateLevel: <label>.<state>.us (state.ny.us, k12.ca.us). usLocality: <label>.<place>.<state>.us (ci.boston.ma.us). usStates: the two-letter state, DC and territory labels under .us; a domain that is exactly <place>.<state>.us for one of them (riverside.ca.us) is the RFC 1480 locality delegation itself and is blocked, while a name one level down (acme.riverside.ca.us) is blocked only when usLocality covers it. employer: owner-edited employer domains; organizations store employer names, not domains, so add a domain here when one is known. Never list a union domain. This list has the opposite purpose of config/catalog-blocked-email-domains.json; do not merge them. The database copy is private.account_blocked_email_domain_rules; tests/account-email-domains.test.js keeps the two equal, so a change here ships with a migration that rewrites the copy.
